input-field.name: referenceDataEnabled
input-field.label: Reference data (countries, subdivisions, currency precision)
input-field.helpText: Enables the africa:reference:import command that activates African countries, seeds ISO 3166-2 subdivisions, and corrects ISO 4217 currency precision.

input-field.name: administrativeHierarchyEnabled
input-field.label: Administrative-division hierarchy (LGAs, sub-counties, cells)
input-field.helpText: Seeds and exposes an optional division tree below country_state (arbitrary depth per country). When on, africa:reference:import also reconciles the shipped divisions.

input-field.name: addressExtensionsEnabled
input-field.label: Additive address fields (landmark, area, directions, digital code)
input-field.helpText: Adds landmark, area, directions, digital address code and (with the hierarchy on) a division picker to the storefront address forms, stored with each customer address.

input-field.name: phoneNormalizationEnabled
input-field.label: Phone normalization (E.164, warn-not-block)
input-field.helpText: Live phone feedback in the address form + the phone-normalize store-API/storefront endpoints. Warns on an invalid number, never blocks.

input-field.name: divisionDepth
input-field.label: Administrative-division depth (global default)
Tiefe der Verwaltungsbezirke (globaler Standard)
input-field.helpText: Tiers of local divisions expected below the state (0 = none). When above 0, the default address validator suggests picking a division. Override per country with bin/console system:config:set KmhAfricaCommerceCoreSW.country.NG.divisionDepth 2.
Erwartete Ebenen lokaler Bezirke unterhalb des Bundeslands (0 = keine). Pro Land überschreibbar mit bin/console system:config:set KmhAfricaCommerceCoreSW.country.NG.divisionDepth 2.

input-field.name: enableDebugging
input-field.label: Enable debug logging
Debug-Protokollierung aktivieren
input-field.helpText: Writes debug, info and warning entries to var/log/kommandhub_africacommercecore_*.log. Errors are always logged regardless of this setting. Can be scoped to a single sales channel.
Schreibt Debug-, Info- und Warnungseinträge nach var/log/kommandhub_africacommercecore_*.log. Fehler werden unabhängig von dieser Einstellung immer protokolliert.

input-field.name: logLevels
input-field.label: Log levels
Protokollstufen
input-field.helpText: Restrict debug logging to specific PSR-3 levels. Leave empty to log every level once debug logging is enabled.
